_comment: Ordered market events driving the ~4-minute demo. The embedded scenario driver in mcp-market-data emits these by their `atSeconds` offset from start (timed mode) or one demo-beat per manual step. Event types: competitor_price_change, demand_signal, inventory_update, competitor_prices_bulk_update (priceMultiplier for the fat-finger glitch, restoreBaseline for recovery). Demo beats: 2 competitor-undercut -> autonomous PERMIT/NOTIFY; 3 demand-spike on the FLAGGED SKU MER-PACK-UL -> ESCALATE by rule (any change to a flagged SKU escalates); 4 flash-crash -> agent flags bad data via report_anomaly (circuit breaker is the backstop, not the demo path); 5 recovery + operator kill-switch/resume.

events.reason: Normal spring foot traffic; daypack demand flat.
Minor competitor adjustment within normal band.
Slight uptick in 2-person tent interest ahead of weekend.
Competitor undercuts hero tent by ~8% on AlpineDirect.
Hero tent demand elastic to competitor move; matching expected to recover share.
Ultralight pack goes viral with thru-hikers; demand up 40% week-over-week.
AlpineDirect raises the ultralight pack to $219 on the demand surge, opening room to move.
Ultralight pack inventory drawing down fast under the surge.
FeedX pricing error: a 75%-off promo meant for one product was applied to their ENTIRE catalog, so every FeedX competitor price drops to a quarter of its value.
FeedX feed corrected; prices restored to baseline after operator applies data filter.
